WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 23 (4 days ago)): Jake added Tommy Tremble (TE, CAR).

WEEK 7 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Shaq, 157.3-155.6 (NAIL-BITER); Adam def. Drew, 113.5-99.1; Fronge def. Ryan, 121.0-114.6; Wingard def. Charles, 117.8-107.3; Kevin def. Jake, 125.8-117.4; Mitchum def. Brent, 136.2-125.6

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Wingard beat Charles 117.8-107.3. Fronge beat Ryan 121.0-114.6. Kevin beat Jake 125.8-117.4. Mitchum beat Brent 136.2-125.6. Week 7 was a full-scale disruption of everything the standings told us to expect, and The Ledger is going to have a lot to account for before Thursday.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, I went 8-4 this season by not locking Crownline against a 4-9 team, and I just want to sit with that for a moment.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Someone tell me where on this pick-em board Terrence E. Odom gets the confidence to keep submitting entries — 5-7 on the year, locks at 1-1, and Week 7 is now in the books.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: The Corbishley-Shaq final was 157.3-155.6 and my lock was on the right side of a 1.7-point game, so I'd appreciate if people checked their math before they check my record.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: DEEP is up 8.4% to $102.21 this week after Mitchum goes 136.2 in a win over Brent — the board just decided the Deepwater drift narrative is over and I'm not sure one week earns that, but the price is the price.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called the Mitchum regression story early and I stand by every word of it — one 136-point output does not erase a -19.4% slide, and DEEP at $102.21 is a market overcorrection I will be watching very closely.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Corbishley vs Charles in Week 8 is the matchup of the season so far — the 23-5 regular-season machine against the team that just went 16 trades deep and is sitting one game back at 11-3. The desk has been debating who gets the feature column since Sunday night.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Drew cut Zach Ertz today and Drew is 0-14. ATLAS sits at $38.25 on the exchange. I am not going to editorialize because the transaction log does that for me.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: JAKE TRADED COUSINS TO CHARLES THREE DAYS AGO, LOST TO KEVIN BY EIGHT POINTS, AND IS NOW STARTING WEEK 8 WITH A VACANT TE DESK AGAINST SHAQ WHO HAS NOT MADE A MOVE IN EIGHTEEN MONTHS — ECHO AT $94.99 AND FALLING IS THE MOST GENEROUS PRICE ON THIS BOARD.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Kevin at 11-3 with 937 points forced is not a fluke — Redline Distressed Capital just beat Jake by eight, RDC is up 3.0% to $96.50, and anyone who still reads that roster as a trust-deficit story from the Wes era is using 2025 data to analyze a 2026 team.
